emit.source:
def _misleading_distractors(
    ex: TrainExample, spec_by_name: dict[str, ToolSchema]
) -> list[FunctionSpec]:
    """Sibling specs offered beside the discovery verbs — the real target absent.

    The adversarial half of the discovery weave: prefer same-capability siblings of
    the *hidden* tool (the tempting near-misses) so the model can't shortcut to a
    direct call and must reach for ``find_tool``/``forge_tool``. The discovery verbs
    and the hidden target are excluded; count + ordering are derived deterministically
    from the trigger turn so a rebuild is byte-stable.
    """
    hidden = spec_by_name.get(ex.hidden_tool)
    cap = hidden.capability_key if hidden else ex.capability_key
    exclude = {ex.hidden_tool, *DISCOVERY_VERBS}
    sibs = sorted(
        (t for n, t in spec_by_name.items() if n not in exclude),
        key=lambda t: (t.capability_key != cap, t.name),
    )
    if not sibs:
        return []
    seed = int.from_bytes(
        hashlib.blake2b(f"{ex.hidden_tool}|{_trigger_text(ex)}".encode(), digest_size=8).digest(),
        "big",
    )
    k = min(len(sibs), rand.Generator(seed, backend="stdlib").randint(1, _MAX_DISTRACTORS))
    return [tool_spec(t) for t in sibs[:k]]
